title: Live Adjustments
description: Live adjustments for an MHD- or MG Flasher-tuned DME, one tab per tune: switch engine maps at any time, also while driving (MHD maps 1-4, MG Flasher maps 1-5), MG Flasher burble slots 0-5, Max Cooling on (engine running) or off, and open or close the exhaust flap (on MHD its own flap control, held while driving; otherwise BMW's DME job, which the DME takes back after about 20 s or when the car moves). Shows what the DME accepted: neither tune has a read-back here. MG Flasher (Custom Code 6.9 or later) is not car-tested yet.
